audit.whatIsWrong: Level-chart stages carried a closing verdict that contradicted the stage owner (for example a stage marked Akshan ending "Camille is favoured here").
audit.why: The full-layer phase text was templated; the tail sentence was never reconciled with phases[].side, so the written verdict and the chart disagreed on the same page.
audit.corrected: Each phase why now closes with the verdict that matches its own side field, so early / mid / side-lane ownership reads consistently.

audit.why: Spike stages line up with the real kits: Camille at 2 (Hookshot, 16s at rank 1), 6 (The Hextech Ultimatum, 140s at rank 1) and her Sheen item; Akshan at Comeuppance (100/85/70).

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 stage told you to "use the cast's brief untargetable frame" on The Hextech Ultimatum to dodge Akshan's key spell.
audit.why: Riot's own description of The Hextech Ultimatum is "Camille dashes to target champion, anchoring them to the area" — there is no untargetable window. The kit file's untargetable/channel flags on R are tooltip-parse misfires and contradict the description.
audit.corrected: The stage now says the dash grants no immunity and keys R to being spent after the enemy spell rather than into it.

edits.before: The Hextech Ultimatum (R) isolates a target in a 1v1 they cannot leave. Use the cast's brief untargetable frame to dodge Akshan's Heroic Swing or burst, then focus the trapped target. Akshan is favoured here.
edits.after: The Hextech Ultimatum (R) isolates a target in a 1v1 they cannot leave. The dash grants no immunity, so spend R once Akshan's Heroic Swing is gone, not into it, then focus the trapped target. Akshan is favoured here.

edits.before: Akshan owns the first three levels here — his Q and W poke outrange you and your E hookshot doesn't exist yet, so you can't walk him down. Don't throw an empowered Q auto into his face for a free Q-and-W trade back; soak the harass on your Adaptive Defense shield and last-hit at max range. The good news is his poke can't kill you outright and he has no real escape once your E is online — just survive to Level 6 without feeding his roam tempo.
edits.after: Akshan owns the first three levels here — his Q and W poke outrange you and your E hookshot doesn't exist yet, so you can't walk him down. Don't throw an empowered Q auto into his face for a free Q-and-W trade back; soak the harass on your Adaptive Defenses shield and last-hit at max range. The good news is his poke can't kill you outright and he has no real escape once your E is online — just survive to Level 6 without feeding his roam tempo.

edits.before: Akshan's Q and W outrange your level-1 abilities and you have no E hookshot to close — last-hit safely and eat poke on your Adaptive Defense shield.
edits.after: Akshan's Q and W outrange your level-1 abilities and you have no E hookshot to close — last-hit safely and eat poke on your Adaptive Defenses shield.

edits.before: Bait his Q/W poke onto your Adaptive Defense shield, then all-in once it whiffs and your E hookshot is up
edits.after: Bait his Q/W poke onto your Adaptive Defenses shield, then all-in once it whiffs and your E hookshot is up

notes: Camille kit file flags R as channel/interruptible and untargetable; both contradict Riot's own description (a dash plus an anchoring zone) and were treated as tooltip-parse misfires, per the kit README. Packet win rate 54.22% over 308 games.
